input.title: Firm Memory Foam Mattress
input.descriptionHtml:
Looking for a firm memory foam mattress at a keen price? The Firm Memory Foam Mattress pairs a firm core with a memory foam comfort layer on top. It is made in the UK, comes in all standard UK sizes from £142.99 (Single 3ft) to £259.99 (Super King 6ft), and is delivered free across Great Britain. 5-year guarantee. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay. Pairs with any Eagle Bed frame, divan or ottoman base.

How does it feel?

The Eagle Bed Firm Memory Foam Mattress adds a memory foam comfort layer on top. The firm core resists compression, and the memory foam layer softens the contact surface so the firmness does not feel harsh. It is compatible with every Eagle Bed base: slatted frame, divan, drawer base and gas lift ottoman.

Firm memory foam or pocket sprung: which one?

Mattress Feel Double 4ft6
Firm Memory Foam (this mattress) Firm support core with a memory foam top £194.99
3000 Pocket Sprung 3,000 independent pocket springs £259.99

Choose the Firm Memory Foam if you want a firm feel at the lowest price. Choose the 3000 Pocket Sprung if you share the bed and want independent springs to reduce partner disturbance. Our pocket sprung vs memory foam guide compares the two types.

Key features

  • Memory foam comfort layer
  • Firm core
  • Thick durable build
  • Hygienic removable cover
  • Available in Single 3ft, Small Double 4ft, Double 4ft6, King 5ft, Super King 6ft

Sizes and prices

Size UK dimensions Price
Single (3FT) 90 x 190cm £142.99
Small Double (4FT) 120 x 190cm £181.99
Standard Double (4FT6) 135 x 190cm £194.99
King (5FT) 150 x 200cm £220.99
Super-King (6FT) 180 x 200cm £259.99

Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

This mattress is a comfort and support product, not a medical device, and we make no medical claims for it.

Delivery, returns & guarantee

Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns if the mattress is unused and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. It is backed by a 5-year guarantee.

Browse all Eagle Bed mattresses, or pair this mattress with an ottoman storage base.

FAQ

What is the Firm Memory Foam Mattress made of?

It has a firm core with a memory foam comfort layer on top and a hygienic removable cover.

Is it firm?

Yes, it is a firm mattress, with the memory foam layer softening the surface.

Will it fit my Eagle Bed frame or divan?

Yes. It is compatible with every Eagle Bed base in the matching size.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the mattress is unused and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
